# Vercel

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 7 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A black developer marketing site on Geist: 64px display, light gray primary buttons, 6px and 8px radii, a blue link, and a signed-out login that stays on the page.

Captured 2026-11-19, Public marketing, Geist docs, and signed-out login. Email was not filled. Signup was not submitted. Google, GitHub, ChatGPT, SAML SSO, and Passkey were not followed. No card was entered. No paid team was created. No org SSO was accepted.. Themes: dark.

Vercel (vercel.com) is a frontend cloud for deploying web apps. This package records the public marketing site, the public Geist design pages, docs, and the signed-out login chrome, measured on 2026-11-19 from a live T3 preview tab. Login shows email plus Google, GitHub, ChatGPT, SAML SSO, and Passkey. None of those were followed. The email field was not filled. Signup was not submitted. No card was entered. No paid team was created. No org SSO was accepted.

The live CSS viewport was 1169 by 731 at devicePixelRatio 2. Marketing, login, pricing, Geist, and docs ship with `html` class `dark-theme` and `color-scheme: dark`. Light was not switched.

## Typography

7 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Geist Mono, GeistSans.

### Fonts (from README.md)

GeistSans is the UI face, computed as `GeistSans, "GeistSans Fallback"`. Geist Mono is the code face, computed on docs `pre` and on Geist button code. The fallback stack named by `--font-sans-fallback` is Inter, then system faces. Geist Serif and Geist Pixel are named on the Geist introduction page. They were not computed on the elements that were measured. Font files are not in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The CSS viewport was 1169, not 1440 and not 390. Do not treat these readings as a 1440 or 390 capture. Light theme exists as a Geist theme switcher at https://vercel.com/geist/theme-switcher and was not opened, so there is no light token set. Primary buttons on marketing and login are light gray (`#ededed`) on black, not the blue `--geist-success` (`#0070f3`). Link and focus are `--ds-blue-900` (`#47a8ff`). The email field's own radius is 0. The 8px radius is on the wrap, whose ring is `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)`. `--ds-gray-alpha-400` (`#ffffff24`) is the nearest named step, and the token stores that named step. Pricing `h1` weight computed as 450, which is not one of the `--font-weight-*` steps. Screenshot folders are empty on purpose.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the black page and the light primary button.** Home, pricing, login, and docs render on `#000000` with `#ededed` text. "Sign Up" and "Continue with Email" are `#ededed` on `#0a0a0a` text. [components.md](components.md) lists the sizes.
- **Use the 1px gray ring for secondary actions.** "Log In" and "Continue with Google" sit on `#0a0a0a` with a `rgb(46, 46, 46)` ring, which matches `--ds-gray-400`. [components.md](components.md) records that ring.
- **Keep login signed out.** https://vercel.com/login offers email, Google, GitHub, ChatGPT, SAML SSO, and Passkey. Do not invent a dashboard behind it. [patterns.md](patterns.md) records what was not entered.
- **Use GeistSans for UI and Geist Mono for code.** The marketing `h1` is 64px weight 400 with letter-spacing `-3.84px`. [tokens.json](tokens.json) keeps both faces.
- **Do not invent a 1440 screenshot.** The preview browser produced no frames. [screenshots/](screenshots/) says so.
